questions.text:
Dylan keeps telling me about a new sponsorship deal for his swim club.
He says it's an incredible opportunity.
Before we go any further — who's he been working that deal with?

They seem to meet up pretty often.
Where is he right now?

He's probably not the only one who can see his location.
Check if he's shared it with someone who has no business knowing where he is.
Which account is it?
questions.hint: Check the location-sharing settings in Google Maps — scroll down to see who it's shared with.

questions.text:
That's a strange email to find...
Who's behind it?
questions.hint: In Gmail, pull up an email from quietwater7 and check the signature.

questions.text:
No more hiding behind "Vance."
I'm dealing with this right now!
What's her phone number?
questions.hint: Check contacts for her phone number.

onboarding.text: They say that whatever someone's covering up, you'll find it. That's exactly the kind of person I need right now.
onboarding.label: Tessa

onboarding.text: I'm Tessa. Two years now with Dylan. Between his job and his swim sessions, money has never been something we had. And lately it's worse than ever — his pay barely covers anything, the swim brings in nothing, and I was let go from my job a few weeks ago.
onboarding.label: Tessa & Dylan

onboarding.text: And yet the money still drains away and I can't trace where it goes. Dylan is out more and more, home later and later, forever glued to his phone. Work and the club, he says. I don't believe it any more. His phone is in my hands — find me what he's hiding.
onboarding.label: Tessa

msgs.text: Hi Dylan, it's Adrienne from the club. I got your request for the jerseys.
Hey Adrienne! Great, can you place the order?
Sure, I'll put it through this afternoon. How many size L?
5 larges and 3 XLs, thanks
Got it, I'll put the order in 👍
Dylan — the sponsorship file, I've made a start on it. Could you read it through when you get five minutes?
Sure, I'll go through it once I'm home tonight
You're a star, thank you!
Hey Dylan, I finished preparing the documents.
Awesome thanks Adrienne!
Can we sit down tomorrow and go through the sponsorship file?
Yeah that works, 2pm at the club?
Great — tomorrow it is 👍
Hey babe — the bread. Did that happen?
Ugh 😬 completely slipped my mind, I'll swing by the store on the way back
Every single time 😂
Guilty as charged... let me cook you something proper tonight to make up for it?
Now you're talking 😘
Still thinking about last night ❤️ dinner was lovely, thank you
Any time babe 😊 I had a really good evening
So what's the plan this weekend?
Weather's meant to be gorgeous — how about a long walk by the lake?
Ohh yes please! We could follow the lakefront path all the way up to Shorewood
Locked in 🤙
You said 7pm. It's 7pm. Where are you?
Sorry, practice went over — 15 min and I'm there
Ok... your dinner's going cold btw
I know, I know 🙏 going as fast as I can
Dylan. I just looked at the joint account. It's practically empty — what's going on?
The club ate a lot of it this month, plus all the usual stuff
The club? I thought that ran off the membership dues??
It does but there's always extras, travel, jerseys, all that
That's 3 months running that we've been in the red, Dylan. Something has to change
I hear you. I'll get a grip on it, promise
You say that every single time. Sit down with me and talk about it properly.
Fair. This weekend, we go through all of it, ok?
Fine.
Did a grocery run, got everything we need for dinner
Aw thanks 🙂 are you the one cooking?
Course I am — carbonara, the one you love
See, you can be lovely when you try 😘
The bank appointment Monday — please don't let that one slip
Relax it's on the calendar! 10am
Good 👍
What time do you think you'll be home?
Around 6:30 usually, how come?
Just checking if we're having dinner together
Yeah obviously ❤️
Cool, see you tonight then 😊
Have a lovely day babe 💪 and practice tonight, remember
Thanks babe, you have a good one too! I've got it 😊
Verizon: Your bill of $29.99 is available. View it at verizon.com/bill
Verizon: Your plan renewed automatically. The next payment comes out 03/05.
Yo the garage keypad won't take the old code anymore?
Yeah I switched it, it's my PayPal one now: Mom's birth year
Got it, writing it down 👍
Bro 😭 you need to see this
Tell me that isn't you at swim practice 💀
No chance 😭
Got a delivery landing at yours tomorrow morning — will you be in?
All good, I'm not out the door till 11am

What show are you on right now on Netflix?
Started Black Mirror. Absolutely wild.
Oh yeah, been meaning to start that one
It's like 3 episodes a season so you'd fly through it
Perfect, that's about my attention span right now 😅
Start with the dating app one, trust me on that
Noted 📺
Any chance of a call tonight bro?
Yeah after practice, say 9:30?
Yeah that's good!
Do you still have grandma's tiramisu recipe anywhere?
Two secs, checking my notes
I don't have it, hit up Mom, she's got it
Right, I'll message her then
Did you guys win yesterday?
Yeah 12-8, we ran them off the pool 💪
That's my guy
So — Mom's birthday. Any plan yet?
Was thinking we grab dinner out, just us, sound good?
Yeah let's do it! Split it down the middle?
Sold. I'll sort the booking and we go halves
Nice one 🤝
That new Damso album — have you got round to it?
Not yet, why, is it worth it?
It goes hard. Even just play the opening track.
Sticking it on tonight 🎧
Anyway — you and Tessa, all good?
Yeah properly good. We're sorting a weekend away by the water next month
Oh sweet!! Where you headed?
Traverse City, fingers crossed
Jealous. Make the most of it 🌊
Have you had Dad on the phone lately?
He rang me Sunday, sounded great. Now he wants to redo the patio apparently
Haha of course 😂 dude's been saying that for like 3 years
We should just go help him out some weekend right?
Yeah for real, let's actually put it on the calendar
Have you got work Saturday?
Nah, why
Wanted to drop your charger back
Oh right, I do need that, swing by whenever
Mom just kept me on the phone 15 min about some new "amazing" restaurant she found
Go on. Another supper club, right?
... yeah 😭😭
LMAOOO that woman will never change
Yo what's the Google Photos login again?
It's sunflower22 — and just use my email again, same family login as Spotify, you always forget lol
Ohhh yeah of course 😅 cheers!!!
Dylan, Thursday practice is off — the pool is shut for maintenance.
Understood Coach. When are we making it up?
Friday same time, 6:15pm. Pass the word to the guys.
Done 👍
Solid work Saturday, all of you. Dylan, that left side defense still needs hours.
Felt it in the water honestly. I'll drill it at practice.
That's the attitude. Tuesday we go through it.
Heads up: regionals are two months out. I need everyone available.
Understood Coach, count me in
Good. Pass it on to Wes as well, I get nothing back from him.
On it, I'll text him
Hi honey, you coming over for dinner Sunday?
Hi Mom! Count us in — Tessa's coming as well
Wonderful! I'll do the scalloped potatoes you like 😊
Oh yes. Best thing you make 😍
Oh I know honey 🥰 See you Sunday then!
Thanks for last night, it was so nice 😘
Any time honey ❤️ and Tessa said lovely things about it too
Sweetie — would you mind collecting my prescription from the pharmacy?
Of course. Where do I find the slip?
It's on the kitchen table, the key's right there
Perfect. I'll drop in tonight on the way home from work then.
Thank you honey ❤️
Pharmacy shuts at 7 right?
7:30 I think honey, but don't leave it too late
On my way over there now
Picked up ✅ bringing them over tomorrow morning
What would I do without you 🥰 thank you darling
Dylan, your dad and I have a weekend in Egg Harbor coming up next week. Anything you'd like us to bring back?
Oh lovely! Bring me some of that cherry jam 😄
Consider it done 😂 love you!
Amazon: Order #402-9381726 is on its way. It should reach you 02/20.
Amazon: Delivered — we left your parcel in the mailbox.
Tell me you watched last night. 3-0 Brewers 🔥
Every second of it 😤 that second goal though
We've gotta hit the stadium next time
Say no more — tickets are on me
Saturday at mine for a hangout, you around?
Definitely. Beers are on me 🍺
Nice 👌
Still on for Saturday?
Course we are — 8pm, mine. Wes and Curt are in as well
See you then 👍
Dylan — poker Friday, are we still on?
I wouldn't miss it. At yours?
Yeah 9, bring chips
See you there 🃏
Lol you took all my money last time 😂
Haha the cards were with me 😎
Rematch, soon as you like!
Any time you like bro
Do you know a decent plumber? Something is dripping under my sink
Hang on, digging it out... the plumber up in Shorewood, 414 555 0185
Is he any good? Last guy took a week to show up
He came out same day for us, ask for a morning slot
Calling him now 🙏
Thanks man, you're the best
5-a-side Thursday evening, you in?
Gutted — swim practice that night
Swim practice again huh 😅 alright, next time then
Marsh — the meeting tomorrow now starts at 2pm.
Understood Mr. Wendt, thank you for the heads up.
Bring the Q4 numbers with you.
They're ready. I'll email them over tonight.
Good.
Marsh, the 15th to the 18th is signed off. Your leave is approved.
Much appreciated, thank you!
Hand your files to Doyle before you go.
Will do, I'll get that sorted this week.
New season of The Bear — have you started it?
Not yet, is it any good?
So good! You've gotta watch it
Right, weekend project then
Oh and I'm doing a cookout at my place Saturday, you coming?
Definitely in. Room for Tessa too?
For sure! The more the merrier 😄
Nice one. What do you want us to bring?
Sausages and some bread, that's all — the grill is my job
Easy 👍
Last night was a blast! Thanks for having us
Anytime bro, we're doing that again soon!
Free tomorrow evening? Could do a quick drink
Can't sorry, practice night
No worries, catch you next time!
Dylan — 2 tickets in my hand for the Brewers on Saturday. In?
Obviously yes. Who are we playing?
Springfield, it's gonna be sick
Count me in. Straight to the stadium?
Yeah find me by the Gate C stand at 7:30
Sorted 👊
WHAT A NIGHT 🔥🔥🔥
STILL SHAKING 😱 that goal at the 89th, honestly
Haha we can go back whenever you want
Is the bike still going or did you shift it?
Still here — $150, though for you 120 and it's yours
Let me sleep on it and I'll come back to you
No rush at all 👍
Hey bud, free to help me move the couch Saturday?
Hi Dad! That works — I'll be over about 10am
Good lad, thanks
Dylan, any idea where the drill went? Your mother has tidied it away again
Haha classic. Garage, top shelf, right hand side as you walk in
Got it. Cheers
How'd your game go yesterday?
We won 12-8! I put away 3 goals
Well done son. Send me the next fixtures, I want to be there
That would be great — schedule coming your way
Dylan — run on Sunday morning?
Hey! Yeah for sure, what time works?
8am down at the lakefront? Easy 10k, nothing mad
Deal, though I make no promises about the easy part 😂
Lol let's see who taps out first
That was a good one this morning. Your engine is better than I gave you credit for
Swimming does that 😄 loved it, same again soon?
Absolutely — shall we say the same slot in 2 weeks?
You know it 💪
Did you clock that new bar that opened on N Oakland Ave?
Nope — what is it, exactly?
Cocktails, proper nice room. We should go
Pricey? That last spot you dragged me to was $16 a drink
Bit better than that, and they do a happy hour
Now you're talking
Knew that'd get you 😄
I'm sold. Friday?
Friday it is 🍸
Orelsan is playing Milwaukee?! Have you seen this??
YES. Book them, right now
Putting 2 on my card — transfer me your half?
Sure! How much are they?
$45 a ticket
Sending it over now 👍
Tickets landed in my email, row 12 🎟️
Nice. Forward it over so I've got mine on my phone
Sent. Don't lose it this time 😂
That was ONE festival
Found an unreal fishing spot out past Wauwatosa
For real? Yeah we've gotta go
Are you about Saturday morning?
Very much so. 7am from yours?
Say less 🎣
What a morning 🔥 that 4.4 lbs smallmouth still has me buzzing
So pumped! We need to go back soon
Absolutely. Next weekend then?
Let me look at my week and confirm 👌
Dylan! Fancy a few games of FIFA later?
Yeah for sure, 9?
Great, see you online
GG on that comeback last night 😂
Lol you were 3-0 up and still lost 4-3 😭
We're not talking about that one... Rematch tonight?
Always 😈
The new Call of Duty is unreal, you need to play it

Alright, sold. I'm grabbing it at the weekend
Finally 🎮
Dylan! Ages since we spoke — how have you been?
Nora! All good here thanks. Are you still Milwaukee based?
Still here — at the hospital these days. We should get a coffee
Nice one. Tessa and I would both be up for that
Great, let's put a date on it 😊
Hey! Saturday 3pm for coffee, that work for you?
Tessa and I can both do that. Whereabouts?
That small coffee place in the Harbor District? It's lovely
Great, we'll see you there
It was so good seeing you two! 🤗
Same here. Tessa had such a good time, let's do it again

Jonah! Of course, I'll be there. What time do you need me?

Afraid so 😂 payment is in pizza

Thanks again for Saturday! My back is wrecked but the new place looks incredible
Haha my back too 😂 so happy for you man!
Come see the place once everything is unpacked
Yes please. When's the housewarming?
Reckon 2-3 weeks. I'll keep you posted
Dylan! How is Tessa getting on?
Hallie! She's doing really well thanks. You?
All good here. My brother has a birthday coming up — any restaurant in Milwaukee you'd recommend?
Odd Duck. Really good food and it won't wreck your budget
Perfect, I'll take a look 😊
Odd Duck was a hit 🙏 thank you for pointing us there
So pleased it worked out 😄
One more thing — did my message ever reach Tessa? Nothing back from her
Probably buried in her phone. I'll get her to look
Thanks, you're the sweetest! 😘
Dylan, what are you up to work wise these days?
Hey! Same firm, same project, nothing new. You?
I moved — Verizon took me on
Oh nice! You liking it there?
Yeah it's great, pay's better and the people are awesome
That's great news, really pleased for you 💪
Cheers man. Lunch one day?
Definitely. Tuesday or Thursday both work for me
Tuesday then — 12:30, The Diplomat?
Locked in 👍
Did you catch the MLR last night bro?
Yeah total blowout 😂 42-10
Honestly the Seattle Seawolves are playing a different game right now
Nobody can lay a hand on Wendt, it's unreal

Me, you, Curt and Wes. Perfect number
Beers are my job 🍺
Good man
That Reyes try though?? 80 meters and nobody near him
I was on my feet shouting at the TV 😂
Same here, Tessa looked at me like I'd lost it haha
Lmaooo 😂😂
Dude that photo I sent you on snap, I saw you screenshotted it
It was from the swim club's insta, I know you don't have insta so I'm sending it to you
They deleted it so it's fine but you could've gotten caught, Tessa doesn't have insta but just in case...
Yeah ffs, yesterday Tessa came over right when I was looking at my phone I nearly had a heart attack, so I didn't even reply to you, I hid the photo. I need to delete it asap
Confirmed lads: Saturday, 3pm, game on!
Noted 👍
Great. Club at 2pm to warm up?
2 works, don't forget your caps
Lost mine somewhere... anyone have a spare?
Spare one in my bag, it's yours
Appreciate it bro 🙏
ABSOLUTELY BATTERED THEM
That last minute goal from Dylan, unreal
Haha thanks fellas 😊 great group
Celebrating tonight? Pizzas at mine
SAY LESS
With you in 1h 🍕
Coach says Tuesday's a hard session, get those legs ready
Ugh not again 😩 last one had me sore for two days
And that is exactly why we win 😂
Can't argue 💪
Saturday in Grand Rapids - who's driving?
My car is free, 3 spots going
Put me in one
Same here!
Sorted. Outside the club at noon, we eat on the road
Yo Dylan! Where are we going this summer then?
Been looking at Spain, flights to Barcelona are cheap right now
You can never go wrong with Barcelona 🇪🇸
Gotta lock it in soon though, prices are creeping up
Right, flights this weekend and then we decide
Are you any good with Excel? My spreadsheet has gone haywire
Depends. What's it doing?
Every VLOOKUP is spitting out #N/A down the whole column
Check your column order first, then make the last argument FALSE
THAT WAS IT. Absolute genius 😂
Haha no big deal, everybody does that once
Gym tomorrow morning, you in?
Yeah 6:15 as usual?
Perfect! Chest and shoulders again?
Chest and shoulders it is 💪
Good session that. Shoulders are cooked
Same 😅 worth it though
Next week we swap to back and legs?
Deal, same time as usual
Dune 2 - seen it yet?
Nah not yet! Is it good?
Stop what you're doing and watch it. Incredible
Right, Tessa and I are going this weekend then
Solid pick 👌
Made a mushroom risotto last night and it was unreal
Recipe. Now. Please
Far too long to type, voice note tomorrow 😂
Sounds good chef 👨‍🍳
We running again Sunday?
Definitely. Shall we do the full 12k this time?
Ambitious, I'm on board. 8am at the lakefront?
See you there 🏃
Strong run this morning! 7.6 miles in 58 min
Well run! 1h02 for me and I'll take it 😄
Solid time. Every run is quicker than the last
What show are you into right now?
Fallout on Prime. Properly good
Oh yeah saw the trailer, need to get on that
Do it, you won't be sorry 👍
Put Laylow's new album on, it's a serious one
Listening to it right now 🎧
And?? What'd you think?
Yeah that goes hard. The Hamza feature 🔥
Called it. Knew that one was for you
What tires are you running? Mine are about done
Michelin Primacy 4 - hard to beat for the money
Thanks! Where'd you pick those up?
The tire place on N Oakland Ave, they fit them there too
Great, I'll swing by 👍
Christmas market is on in Milwaukee this weekend!
Oh yeah we've gotta go! That hot cider last year was unreal
Right? Does Saturday afternoon suit you?
Tessa's coming with me - shall we meet at Cathedral Square?
Perfect 🎄
